question: Can refe/onpolicy_dump.py dump a FIXED generator checkpoint's 64 proposals over a GIVEN key list into the set format that onpolicy_relabel_pdm.py and rl_terms_label.py consume?
answer: Not as shipped. It can load the right generator and it can run on a fixed checkpoint, but it cannot take a key list and it does not write the consumers' format. Four small edits, one new ~40-line writer. NOTHING was built (read-only check).

can_already.detail: ckpt_io.load_for_inference accepts BOTH formats (FULL model_final.pt: strict load; PARTIAL ckpt_last.pt: trunk + load_partial with the recorded frozen fingerprint). ckpt_last.pt at step 10,075 is the same generator as model_final.pt: all 276 trainable tensors bit-identical, equal frozen-trunk fingerprints.

the watcher at onpolicy_dump.py:104 reloads only when ckpt_last.pt is NEWER than the one it started with; pointed at a finished run dir it never reloads. That is how the 22,742 existing step-10,075 sets were produced.
can_already.evidence: M source read; dump.log line 10004 'reloaded ckpt_last.pt at step 10075'

can_already.detail: --ranks 0 selects rank-0 rows only; rank-1 rows carry route/goal augmentations (aug) that navtest does not have.
can_already.evidence: M onpolicy_dump.py:60,85; aug null on rank 0 in the banked sets

can_already.detail: ds = T.TargetBank(...): images, ego, goal, per-sample rig exactly as training builds them (bf16 autocast + TF32, batch 4).

missing.detail: by_rank (onpolicy_dump.py:85) is every row of the bank, shuffled by seed 20260926+rank; there is no --keys. Needs: --keys <token list / rl_train+rl_val scenes TSV> restricting by_rank, and --shard I/N so several processes can split the list.

missing.what: checkpoint path and step are hard-wired to a live run dir
missing.detail: ck = <run-dir>/ckpt_last.pt (l.72) and ckpt_step = st['state']['step'] (l.77): a FULL model_final.pt has keys format/model/meta and NO 'state', so --run-dir cannot point at it (KeyError). Needs: --ckpt PATH, --ckpt-step N (default: state.step when present, else meta.step = 10075) and --fixed (never reload). Pointing --run-dir at a dir holding the finished run's ckpt_last.pt works TODAY and gives the same generator.

missing.what: wrong output kind for the consumers
missing.detail: the dumper writes kind 'onpolicy_props' queue chunks (props [M][T][3], onpolicy_dump.py:140). onpolicy_relabel_pdm.py (l.126-144) and rl_terms_label.py (l.484-495) read ONLY 'onpolicy_set' lines in onpolicy_*.jsonl: kind, log_name, token, step, rank, ckpt_step, label_version, traj [M][T][2], yaw [M][T]. The only existing producer of onpolicy_set is onpolicy_label.py (teacher simulator). Needs a lean writer props -> onpolicy_set (traj = props[..., :2], yaw = props[..., 2], label_version 3, rounding 5/6 decimals as onpolicy_label.py:396-397).

missing.what: the trainer's loader needs a 'targets' field
missing.detail: train.OnPolicyBank (the loader scorer_finetune.py uses for --onpolicy) skips a line without targets of shape [M] (n_incomplete). ScorerBank.components({}) is defined for an empty dict (all keys default), and _apply_pdm_labels then OVERWRITES all six components, so the lean writer can emit targets = [{}]*M and --require-pdm serves only PDM-labelled sets. This avoids the teacher labeller entirely; UNTESTED end to end (needs the train-side smoke on the pod).

the dump runs the trainer's numerics (bf16 autocast, TF32, batch 4, eval mode); the navtest fan comes from the eval planner. Same weights, but the 64 proposals may differ in the last bits. Not measured. Probe before launch: re-dump 20 navtest tokens and take max |delta| against eval/raw proposals.

missing.what: inputs live only on a pod
missing.detail: --images needs navtrain_pixels (80 GB, not retrieved to the dev box); the labellers need navtrain_dbs (164 GB, not retrieved). The dev-box RTX 4060 cannot substitute. The A40 is P2's first (PI order P2 -> RL-S1 -> P6) and CLAUDE.md forbids adding GPU load to a training pod.

reuse.unbiased: the dump order is random.Random(20260926 + rank).shuffle (onpolicy_dump.py:86-87) walked by a cursor, so the rows dumped at step 10,075 are a contiguous slice of a seeded permutation: a random subset of tokens. Reusing them in RL-train / RL-val introduces no selection by token properties (E, argued from the source; not tested).
reuse.still_needs: PDM labels and rl_terms for them: the original PDM labels (train_pdm) lived only on the pod.

dump_s_per_sample_standalone.evidence: M dump.log (inside onpolicy_sets_logs_full.tar.zst), chunks written at ckpt 10,075 after the trainer had stopped, labellers concurrent

dump_s_per_sample_with_live_trainer.evidence: M same log, ckpt 3,647 (8 chunks) and 0.40 at 3,688 (23 chunks)

AVOID_teacher_onpolicy_label.evidence: M the banked set lines' own 'sec' field; measured while the trainer shared the pod's 7.65 CPUs, so an upper bound. This is the cost F4's placeholder-targets route avoids.

not_built: onpolicy_dump.py was not edited. F1-F4 are a ~60-line change plus a test; F5 and the F4 smoke need a pod.
